advancements.doctor_m.root.title: DOCTOR M
advancements.doctor_m.root.description: Why is it called DOCTOR M? En... DOCTOR MOD, DOCTOR MC, anyway, it has multiple meanings~
advancements.doctor_m.enter_trenzalore.d: In a snow-covered town, an aged warrior is about to face his final hour, and his glorious old body is about to begin a new chapter.
advancements.doctor_m.obtain_time_key.de: We have the power to do anything we want. Absolute control over every particle in the universe. Absolute control over everything that has ever existed and everything that will ever exist. Are you listening to me, Romana? Because if you're not, I can make you listen, for I can do anything. From this moment, there is no free will in the entire universe. Only my will, because I possess the Key of Time!
message.doctor_m.rassilon_key.tooltip.li: No Time Lord president has ever been able to obtain the Key of Rassilon except Rassilon himself...
message.doctor_m.de_mat_gun.tooltip.line: Destroy this gun, destroy all its data, and do not let its immense power corrupt your mind...
message.doctor_m.time_key_resurrection: §bOwner of the Time Key, your power extends beyond this. Death is merely a trivial matter for you. The Hexapod God is still watching over you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.tip: §6A crystal that may have countless origins.*Rassilon once possessed it, or perhaps its creator.*Now, you have obtained it, and the universe will bow before you.
message.doctor_m.time_key.detail: §dWith this power, you will rise above even the Time Guardians.*When you 「Die」, you will be resurrected and instantly kill all enemies within 10 blocks.*Any damage dealt to you is capped at 15% of your max health, and arrows will be erased by your power.*You will heal 10% of your max health every second and be extinguished of fire.*You gain the ability to fly and become immune to various types of damage.*You can toggle Forced Neutrality or Full Damage Immunity on/off.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.tip: §bA golden pocket watch...*It looks ordinary, maybe.
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.revived: §dYour journey has not yet reached its end. The Hexapod God watches you, anticipating where your path will ultimately lead...
message.doctor_m.pocket_watch.cooldown: §cThe pocket watch cannot protect you indefinitely. You must wait for it to recover. Time remaining: %s
